author: Mark Atwood
text:
Filed as descendant of JMAP-h47t but the actual work is workspace-wide (120 handle_* fns across 7 sibling extension-server crates plus the canonical mail-server). Suggest re-parenting as top-level workspace-sweep like JMAP-k9va (Id::from sweep) and JMAP-7g82 (MemoryError sweep) — same shape as those existing sweep beads. Leaving open for the next /do-beads session to pick up at workspace scope, or for the owner to schedule explicitly.

Decomposition plan if worked: 7 per-crate child beads (mail-server canonical first per propagation rule; then chat, calendars, contacts, filenode, metadata, sharing). Mail-server has 32 handle_* fns and is the biggest; the smallest is metadata-server at 5. Each child is mechanical pure-docs adding the wire-shape rustdoc shape demonstrated in commit 216cc61 on JMAP-h47t.17.
